in_sanskrit.name: Samadhan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Tranquility of mind
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Samadhan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A state of deep concentration and complete absorption in an object, thought, or activity, leading to a profound sense of peace and self-realization.

in_hindi.name: Samadhan
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Tranquility of mind
in_hindi.long_meaning: Samadhan एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A state of deep concentration and complete absorption in an object, thought, or activity, leading to a profound sense of peace and self-realization.

in_tamil.name: Samadhan
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Tranquility of mind
in_tamil.long_meaning: Samadhan ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। A state of deep concentration and complete absorption in an object, thought, or activity, leading to a profound sense of peace and self-realization.

in_telugu.name: Samadhan
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Tranquility of mind
in_telugu.long_meaning: Samadhan ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। A state of deep concentration and complete absorption in an object, thought, or activity, leading to a profound sense of peace and self-realization.

in_marathi.name: Samadhan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Tranquility of mind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Samadhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A state of deep concentration and complete absorption in an object, thought, or activity, leading to a profound sense of peace and self-realization.

in_bengali.name: Samadhan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Tranquility of mind
in_bengali.long_meaning: Samadhan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A state of deep concentration and complete absorption in an object, thought, or activity, leading to a profound sense of peace and self-realization.
